          v10.47.0 paid-pilot safety boundary
          

          Owner-approved · Worker-controlled · six images per request
          The paid path is available only when the v10.54 Worker reports every approved gate ready.
          The browser holds no provider secret. The Worker enforces the invited code, one protected request per session, two requests/IP/24h, US$10 pilot cap, US$0.90 request ceiling, no-store policy, and server kill switch before any OpenAI request can start.
          

          

          

          v9.3 approved pilot brief
          

          

          Owner approved · deployment-controlled activation
          

          Recommended smallest pilot: OpenAI GPT Image 2 through a Cloudflare Worker.
          

          This combination keeps the image API key server-side, fits the existing Cloudflare-hosted site, supports photo editing from one property image, and allows one carefully capped concept render while the free calibrated overlay remains the default.
          

          

          ProviderOpenAI GPT Image 2Six distinct image edits using the same property photo.
          

          BackendCloudflare WorkerPaid Workers plan recommended for the pilot.

          Pilot budgetUS$10 totalIncludes a US$5 Worker month plus provider buffer.
          

          Tester limit10 invited testersOne six-image request per session; two requests per IP per 24 hours.
          

          RetentionNo app server storageInput and output pass through; operational logs exclude photos and prompts.
          

          Expected waitVariable; allow up to 2 minutes120-second app timeout; no provider SLA is promised.
          

          FallbackFree calibrated overlayAlways available before, during, and after failure.

Secure pilot architecturePrepared backend contract

          

          One-image request contract
          

          Prepared endpoints:GET /api/render/providersPOST /api/render/estimatePOST /api/render
          

          POST /api/render
{
  provider: "openai-gpt-image-2",
  buildVersion: "9.2.2",
  count: 1,
  sessionId,
  accessCode,
  propertySituation,
  recommendedFuture,
  selectedFuture,
  calibration,
  prompt,
  imageDataUrl,
  imageBytes,
  metadataStripped: true,
  confirmRender: true,
  confirmPrivacy: true,
  confirmImageUse: true,
  confirmConceptOnly: true,
  confirmCost: true,
  maxCostUsd: 0.15,
  fallback: "calibrated-overlay"
}
          

          

          

          

          

          Calibration-aware render prompt
          

          

          The prompt includes the property situation, recommended and selected futures, usable ground, keep-clear areas, access route, opportunity point, marker 5, and the property-specific first move.
          

          

          

          

          

          

          Deployment
          v10.47.0 Owner-Paid Render Activation
          This build keeps the verified v10.46.1 planning flow and connects one optional paid AI concept through a separate v10.47 Worker only after its server-side safety gates pass.
          1. Deploy the new Worker in locked mode first.
          2. Add the three Worker secrets without placing them in the frontend or GitHub.
          3. Verify locked health, then explicitly release the approved caps.
          4. Run one owner-only real-photo paid render from localhost before changing the public frontend.
          5. Check the result, Worker safeguards, and actual provider usage.
          6. Only after the owner test passes should the v10.47 frontend replace the protected v10.46.1 live baseline.
          Safety boundary: one image only, invited access code required, US$0.15 reservation per request, US$5 provider reservation cap, 10 invited testers, no app server image storage, and an immediate server-side safe-lock configuration.

          Tester Mode
          60-second tester pass
          Real tester responses remain separate from owner/internal checks, so practice clicks cannot quietly become fake evidence.
          Owner shortcut:
          Use this first when you just want to check the planning flow without uploading the same photo again.
          1. Upload one real property photo or use demo mode.
          2. Use the Next best action button if unsure.
          3. Tap the closest starter suggestion and review the recommendation.
          4. Check Plants, Where, Start, and Nursery.
          5. If invited, optionally create one AI concept for the recommended future.
          6. Save feedback before leaving, or tell the owner what felt fake or useful.
          Questions for testers
          • Did the six futures make you see the property differently?
          • Did the result feel specific to the photo and situation?
          • Which future would you actually try?
          • Was one first action clear enough?
          • If you used the optional AI concept, did it still look like your property?
          • What felt fake, confusing, or unfinished?
